pet_notes: Accessible chibi jiangshi familiar with a restrained floating silhouette and dry, judgmental personality. Preserve pale green skin; large amber eyes with heavy lids and skeptical side-eye; arched brows; tiny paired fangs; oversized black round official hat with aged gold trim, red top tassel, and centered yellow forehead talisman bearing a simple red ornamental seal-like motif; short black hair; dark charcoal robe with broad sleeves, deep teal lining and cloud panels, aged gold piping, jade clasp and waist ornament, red waist tassel; small black-and-gold shoes. Small-size priorities: face and eyes first, hat-plus-talisman silhouette second, wide sleeves and robe third. No scenery, shadows, detached effects, symbols outside the attached talisman, or extra props.
style_notes: Faithful stylized 3D chibi toy rendering from the reference, simplified only for 60px readability; compact full-body proportions, soft fabric and aged-metal materials, restrained motion, clean flat chroma background.

visual_decisions.identity: Pale green chibi jiangshi with heavy-lidded amber eyes, tiny paired fangs, an oversized black-and-aged-gold official hat, attached yellow forehead talisman with red seal, charcoal robe with teal lining and cloud panels, jade ornaments, red tassels, and black-and-gold shoes.
visual_decisions.personality: Dryly skeptical, composed, discerning, quietly helpful, and endearingly judgmental.
visual_decisions.small_size_priority: Face and amber eyes first; hat-and-talisman silhouette second; broad sleeves and bell-shaped robe third.
visual_decisions.attached_features: Hat, talisman, jade ornaments, and tassels remain physically attached in every state; no detached effects or extra props were introduced.
visual_decisions.running_left: Safely derived by framewise mirroring of the approved running-right row; the centered attached details and lack of a one-sided held prop preserve identity.
visual_decisions.look_mechanics: The lower robe and shoes stay anchored while eyes, lids, brows, head, hat, and attached talisman communicate direction; tassels follow with restrained secondary motion and the whole sprite is never rotated.

look_directions_row_9.qa_note: All eight registered poses preserve identity and attachment while advancing coherently from unmistakable up through right to down-right without reversal, clipping, scale pop, registration jump, or whole-sprite rotation.

directions.observed: Horizontal: pupils, nose, and talisman remain centered and the ears are symmetric; vertical: irises sit high, lids open upward, chin lifts, and the hat-brim underside is exposed.
Horizontal: pupils and nose begin shifting screen-right with slight rightward head yaw and talisman-plane turn; vertical: eyes remain high and the chin stays lifted.
directions.reason: Clear first clockwise step into the up-right quadrant.

directions.observed: Horizontal: face center, nose, pupils, hat, and talisman yaw farther screen-right; vertical: high irises and raised chin retain a strong upward component.
Horizontal: pronounced screen-right yaw compresses the far cheek and angles the hat and talisman plane; vertical: pupils remain above center and the head is still pitched upward.
Horizontal: face center, nose, pupils, chin, sleeves, hat, and narrowed talisman plane all point unmistakably screen-right; vertical: pupils and pitch settle near neutral.
directions.reason: Unambiguous right cardinal without whole-sprite rotation.

directions.observed: Horizontal: restrained rightward yaw persists across pupils, nose, cheek, hat, and talisman; vertical: irises drop below center, upper lids lower, and the chin begins to tuck.
directions.reason: Clear first clockwise step into the down-right quadrant.

directions.observed: Horizontal: face and hat remain distinctly yawed screen-right with the talisman side-on; vertical: pupils sit lower, lids descend, chin tucks further, and more upper brim plane appears.
Horizontal: a residual screen-right nose, pupil, cheek, and talisman-plane offset remains; vertical: strongly lowered irises, heavy lids, tucked chin, and visible upper brim plane approach down.
directions.reason: Correct near-down intermediate with preserved rightward component.

look_directions_row_10.qa_note: All eight row-10 poses preserve identity, registration, attachments, and scale while advancing coherently from unmistakable down through left to up-left, with both row boundaries forming ordinary 22.5-degree steps.

directions.observed: Horizontal: pupils, nose, chin, and talisman remain centered with symmetric ears; vertical: irises sit low beneath heavy lids, chin tucks, and the hat brim shows its top plane.
Horizontal: pupils, nose, face center, hat, and talisman plane begin shifting screen-left; vertical: lowered irises, heavy lids, and tucked chin retain the downward component.
directions.reason: Clear first clockwise step into the down-left quadrant.

directions.observed: Horizontal: face, pupils, nose, hat, and talisman yaw farther screen-left with the near cheek and ear opening; vertical: eyes remain low and the chin stays tucked.
Horizontal: pronounced screen-left yaw compresses the far cheek and narrows the talisman plane; vertical: pupils remain below center and the head is still pitched downward.
Horizontal: pupils, nose, face center, chin, sleeves, hat, and side-on talisman point unmistakably screen-left; vertical: pupil height and head pitch settle near neutral.
directions.reason: Unambiguous left cardinal without whole-sprite rotation.

directions.observed: Horizontal: restrained screen-left yaw persists across pupils, nose, cheek, hat, and talisman; vertical: irises rise, lids open slightly, and the chin begins lifting.
directions.reason: Clear first clockwise step into the up-left quadrant.

directions.observed: Horizontal: face and hat remain distinctly yawed screen-left with the talisman angled on the forehead plane; vertical: pupils sit high, brows and lids open upward, and the chin lifts further.
Horizontal: a residual screen-left pupil, nose, cheek, and talisman-plane offset remains; vertical: strongly raised irises, lifted chin, and visible brim underside approach up.
directions.reason: Correct near-up intermediate with preserved leftward component.

look_directions_row_10.boundary_evidence: At 157.5 to 180 the remaining rightward yaw recenters while the low gaze deepens smoothly, and at 337.5 to 000 the remaining leftward yaw recenters while the already raised gaze resolves upward; neither boundary shows a snap, reversal, scale change, registration jump, attachment break, or whole-sprite rotation.
